component.name: Sonata
component.summary: High-fidelity music player for Local Music, self-hosted servers, and streaming

description.p: Sonata is a fast, native desktop and terminal music player built in Rust with GPUI and Ratatui. It supports offline Local Music collections, self-hosted Jellyfin, Subsonic/Navidrome, WebDAV, and SMB servers, YouTube Music and Spotify metadata with Hi-Fi upgrades, word-synced karaoke lyrics, animated album artwork, and LAN playback handoff via Sonata Connect.

ul.li: Bit-transparent playback powered by mpv with real-time codec/kbps measurement, gapless transitions, and 0–12 s crossfade
Local Music folder scanning plus self-hosted Jellyfin, Subsonic, WebDAV, and SMB sources with optional Personal Only Mode
29 live-reloading CSS themes, compositor blur, and dual-hue ambient fullscreen backdrops
Multi-source word-synced lyrics (TTML, Enhanced LRC, LRCLIB) with live translation and romanization
MPRIS2 media controls, system tray integration, Discord Rich Presence, and Last.fm / ListenBrainz scrobbling
Includes both the GPUI desktop app (sonata-desktop) and the Ratatui terminal client (sonata)

description.p: Added self-hosted Jellyfin, Subsonic, WebDAV, and SMB music servers alongside Local Music scanning and Personal Only Mode, Sonata Connect LAN handoff, gapless and 0–12 s crossfade transitions, live bitrate measurement, Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobbling, Music/Video switching, playlist pinning, and English/Turkish/Russian localization.
